snippet.title: Tidy Arcana Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
While you were away, a jealous wizard turned your library upside down, and scattered 1,560 items throughout your library: 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to be precise!

Features:
Sort 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions.
Restore 14 book collections and nine potion families.
Match book designs and potion shapes to their shelf signs.
Carry up to seven items at once.
Choose which items to collect and which shelves to complete first.
See a placement preview before shelving a compatible item.
Use Help Me Find to highlight a selected item type and its shelf.
Pet, rename and customize your wizard cat.
Play without timers, penalties or failure states.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5183750/Tidy_Arcana
